videos.caption: Cola chicken wings (可乐鸡翅) 🍗 Believe it or not, cooking chicken wings with Coke is totally normal in Chinese home cooking. I added rice cakes because their chewy texture goes so well with the sweet and sticky sauce. I ate these all the time growing up, and honestly I still love it just as much today. Full recipe on my Substack (link in bio) - ~1 lb chicken wings (12–14 pieces) - 1½ cups rice cakes (200 g) - 4 slices ginger - 1 (12 oz) can @cola - 2 tbsp soy sauce - 2 tbsp dark soy sauce - ½ tbsp oyster sauce - ½ tbsp lemon juice #chicken #chickenwings #coke #chinesefood #easyrecipe

Raising chickens for meat has changed the way we look at food. 🐓❤️ It’s not just about putting food on the table. It’s about knowing where it came from, how it was raised, and the life it lived. We believe that if we’re going to raise animals for food, we have a responsibility to give them the best life we can. Fresh air. Sunshine. Room to roam. A life worth living. ❤️ Our goal isn’t just to produce our own food. It’s to raise it with care, respect, and purpose. And there’s something incredibly rewarding about that. 🌱 Follow Family First Farmstead as we learn to become more self-sufficient, one step at a time. Would you ever raise your own chickens for meat? 👇
